item.title: GREENHEART LUMBER
item.description:
Transportation | Public Comment on Contract Awards | Notice

This is a notice that the Department of Transportation is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below.

Contract Type: Purchase Order/Contract
Contractor: The Piling Company
Contractor Address: 1001 S Myrtle Avenue, Suite A, Clearwater, FL 33756
Scope of Services: To procure Greenheart Lumber
Maximum Value: $250,000.00
Term: Notice to proceed through 8/2/2029
E-PIN: 84126W0079001
Procurement Method: MWBE Non-Competitive Small Purchase 
Procurement Policy Board Rule: Rule 3-08 (c)(1)(iv)
 
How can I comment on this proposed contract award?
Please submit your comment to: https://forms.office.com/g/R66ifPbZPV. Be sure to include the E-PIN above in your message.

Comments must be submitted before 5:00 P.M. on Friday, May 29, 2026.
